method: Fresh affected observations come only from the pinned independent reference adapter, never Kekule. Every source identity and old/new outcome was paired. The comparison of field names maps unpaired_electrons to radical_electrons and old spin labels to numeric multiplicity for the audit only. All non-spin measurements and status transitions are unchanged. Other archives retain byte-identical payloads after verifying absence of affected fields and unchanged contract clauses.

validation.native_selection: One source ID per dataset; not a full native corpus comparison.
validation.scope: Benchmark harness, reference data and documentation only. Runtime workspace tests, runtime package verification, Linux and fuzz checks were not repeated because runtime code was unchanged; validation ran on Windows. The full native benchmark was not rerun.
